sloka: बालः च अकृतबुद्धिः च एक पुत्रः च मे प्रियः ।तारेयो राम भवता रक्षणीयो महाबलः ॥४-१८-५२॥
transliteration: bālaḥ ca akṛtabuddhiḥ ca eka putraḥ ca me priyaḥ ।tāreyo rāma bhavatā rakṣaṇīyo mahābalaḥ ॥4-18-52॥

translations.english: 'I loved him very much from his childhood. He will grow depressed in my absence. He will become like a pond whose waters have been dried up.
